problem: Startup-only host memory reserve missed pressure arising during bank writes and free generation.
fix: Latch pressure stop before model allocation, each source encoding, periodic scoring progress, and generation boundaries. Atomic bank transactions roll back and completed generation rows publish before exit; errors report the reserve condition. Source compute uses the enabled device-aware watchdog and disk reserves precede writes.
validation: Injected host pressure midway through offline writing and after five generations. Retry rebuilds the uncommitted bank; generation resume forbids writer/scoring repetition and matches uninterrupted results.
limits: No mid-kernel preemption or actual system-memory exhaustion test. The running capacity study remains frozen at b38564a.
